decisions.reason: Builds directly on the firm's core footwear expertise, allowing effective learning from early market feedback.
Adjacent to core footwear but requires some new materials knowledge; the firm can assimilate it through existing R&D.
Similar to comfort insoles but more specialized; the firm can leverage existing insole development to improve.
Close to the safety shoe line with an additional ergonomic focus; strong related knowledge supports interpretation and improvement.

Firefighter and rescue boots require specialized certifications and heat-resistant materials outside the firm's traditional leather expertise, limiting absorptive capacity and making early results hard to interpret.
Moulded insoles build on the firm's knowledge of foot shapes and lasts, and its prominent website placement suggests strategic commitment and learning.
